==Overview==
'''Unnamed Sector''' is a Side Quest Section for R:FF:R.
The door will spawn after both a 1 in 90, and a 1 in [Number of rare rooms in the section] is rolled successfully, it can Spawn in Section
[[Section A| A (A-100+)]] [[Section D| D (Derelict only)]], and [[Section M| M (Maintenance Tunnels Only)]]. The objective of the player in the '''Unnamed Sector''' is to find the '''Strange Keycard''', Which can spawn after door 100, and find an escape Door, which can spawn if the player has the Keycard in their inventory, once past the 1st exit door, [[Mouth|False-300]] will chase them forward until they reach the true exit door, leading to an elevator that goes back to the [[Section A]] lobby, where they can use the S.P.A.W.N Terminal to teleport to '''M-400''' if reached already, and use the Keycard to unlock the door for [[Section E]]

== Trivia ==
* [[Mori]], [[Tackle]], [[False Witness]], and [[False-60]] Have a 1 in 2000 chance of spawning outside of the Unnamed Sector after door 500
** Unless the '''Are you.. supposed to be here''' [[Modifiers|Modifier]] is active, in which case its 1 in 200
* The Unnamed Sector had a demo that lasted 50 rooms, and [[Mori]], [[False Witness]],  and [[Tackle]] were the only threats
